searchField.default_description_word:
Did you know that your application will be examined by IP Australia once it is filed? This is when IP Australia can object to your application, including on the basis of prior trademarks which may already be filed or registered.

Before you apply to register your trademark, it is always a good idea to conduct a search of the IP Australia trademark database to see whether the trademark is available for registration. The TradeMark Factory online application platform will conduct an exact word trademark search of IP Australia's trademark database before you submit your application to us for filing.

Our search will reveal exact word trademarks only so to obtain a more comprehensive trademark search before you file, get in touch with us.

*Only words can be searched via our online platform. If you require a logo search, get in touch with us.

searchClasses.title: Add your goods and/or services
searchClasses.default_title: What are classes of goods and services?
searchClasses.default_description:
Trademarks must be registered for goods and/or services which are divided into "classes".

Registering your trademark offers protection for the goods and/or services you provide. You need to select the goods/services relevant to your trade mark. Your application can cover more than one "class". For example "computer software" is in class 9 whereas "computer services" are in class 42.

Please enter simple keywords (one or two at a time is best) to find and specify your desired goods or services. For example, simple keywords include: software, clothing, advertising, computer programming, business, financial, retail, management, machine, book, car, furniture.

You may choose as many goods/services as you like. You can select more than one items in each class if needed. Remember to click the “see more” button to drop down additional goods/services (where available).

Once you have selected all of your goods/services, they will be listed in the side bar for your review before moving on with the application.
